name: wishtoken-desktop
description: WishToken companion for local Codex accounts, explicit channels and existing workspaces
author: WishToken Desktop contributors

scripts.pack:win: npm run backend -- win32 x64 && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run backend -- win32 x64 && electron-builder --win zip nsis --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run backend -- darwin arm64 && npm run backend -- darwin x64 && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run backend -- linux x64 && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64
scripts.pack:mac:cross: npm run backend -- darwin arm64 && npm run backend -- darwin x64 && node scripts/package-mac.cjs
